Noesis Capital Mangement Lifted Holding in Apple (AAPL); As Jd Com (JD) Stock Value Declined, Holder Teacher Retirement System Of Texas Has Increased Its Position
May 20, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Noesis Capital Mangement Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 10.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp bought 1,782 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,026 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.22 million, up from 17,244 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $915.74B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.36% or $0.68 $186.31. About 16.17M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Teacher Retirement System Of Texas increased its stake in Jd Com Inc (JD) by 26.63% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Teacher Retirement System Of Texas bought 21,619 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.51% with the market. The institutional investor held 102,804 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.26M, up from 81,185 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Teacher Retirement System Of Texas who had been investing in Jd Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $50.97 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.70% or $0.25 $35.71. About 8.87 million shares traded. JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) has risen 29.73% uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.18% the S&P500.
Among 22 analysts covering JD.com ( NASDAQ:JD ), 16 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 73% are positive. JD.com had 52 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The company was downgraded on Wednesday, May 9 by J.P. Morgan. Bank of America maintained the shares of JD in report on Thursday, August 11 with “Neutral” rating. The company was maintained on Wednesday, August 16 by Cowen & Co. As per Tuesday, November 14, the company rating was downgraded by Morgan Stanley. KeyBanc Capital Markets maintained the shares of JD in report on Thursday, October 19 with “Buy” rating. As per Tuesday, September 26, the company rating was initiated by Wells Fargo. The stock has “Buy” rating by Nomura on Tuesday, November 14. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Tuesday, November 10 by HSBC. KeyBanc Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Thursday, January 25 report. The rating was maintained by Jefferies on Thursday, August 11 with “Buy”.
Teacher Retirement System Of Texas, which manages about $14.97B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in American Tower Corp New (NYSE:AMT) by 5,655 shares to 208,658 shares, valued at $29.77 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Hca Healthcare Inc (NYSE:HCA) by 598,526 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 79,085 shares, and cut its stake in Abbvie Inc (NYSE:ABBV).
